A food label for flavoured biscuits lists “Antioxidants (E304, E307b [from Soy])”. Which of the following is added to food packets for the same reason?
(A) salt
(B) vinegar
(C) nitrogen
(D) vanilla

text: C. Nitrogen. In the food label, E304 and E307b are antioxidants; nitrogen is used for the same antioxidant purpose.
